messages.subject: [rkward-users] KF5 based RKWard
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
as upcoming KDE applications 17.12 is going to completely drop KDE4/Qt4 
support, which will cause removal of RKWard 0.6.5 (depending on KDE4/Qt4), as 
user of openSUSE Tumbleweed (running the newest applications), I gave a try to 
the latest developmental version of RKWard 0.6.9git.20171022T093... kindly 
packaged in home:wolfi323, https://software.opensuse.org/package/rkward I was 
very happy with its state. UI is old good the same and so far I did not notice 
any major issues. So I hope version 0.7 will be officially available soon.
Thank You!
V.

-- 
Vojtěch Zeisek

Komunita openSUSE GNU/Linuxu
Community of the openSUSE GNU/Linux

https://www.opensuse.org/
https://trapa.cz/
